about: SPARC's shared key-grammar contract, vendored so the conformance test runs without a network.
sparc#1161 made SPARC the source of truth for the grammar and its vectors; Horizon consumes it.
The file originated here, as fixtures/key-vectors.v1.json, and was regenerated upstream under
the registered namespace before SPARC extended it with field lists, type rules and the dedup rule.
TestVendoredContractMatchesItsProvenance recomputes the digest: a vendored contract nobody can
check is indistinguishable from one somebody edited to make a test pass.

upstream.issues: sparc#1155 (namespace registration), sparc#1161 (ports and shared vectors)
